ios.desc:
Pixel Forecast brings weather to life with stunning pixel art animations that react to real-time conditions.

BEAUTIFUL & DYNAMIC
• Watch the scene transform from sunrise to sunset
• Pixel art backgrounds change with weather conditions - sunny, cloudy, rain, and snow
• A peaceful island scene that mirrors the world outside your window

SIMPLE & INFORMATIVE
• Current temperature and conditions at a glance
• Hourly forecast for the next 24 hours
• 7-day forecast to plan your week
• High and low temperatures for each day

DESIGNED WITH CARE
• Retro pixel art aesthetic with modern functionality
• Clean, distraction-free interface
• Works with your current location or search for any city

Pixel Forecast uses Apple WeatherKit for accurate, reliable weather data.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Pixel Forecast – a pixel-art weather app

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I just released an iOS weather app called Pixel Forecast.

Instead of static icons, it shows a pixel-art scene that changes with the real weather. Each condition (rain, snow, cloudy, clear, partly cloudy) has its own animation, and the scene also shifts between morning, afternoon, evening, and night.

All the animations are perfectly looping and modeled in Blender. I’m currently working on additional scenes and animations.

App Store link:
https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/pixel-forecast/id6758243523

Would love any feedback on the visuals, UX, or features you’d expect from a weather app.
